description: SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 faults from the JAX-WS reference implementation in JDK 8, for the three ways DocVault's LockDocument refuses a call.
client: scripts/record.mjs: a raw TCP socket from the host to the published port; each request is written as listed, with Content-Length and Connection: close added.
substitutions: DocVault's LockDocument is documented as a contractor's SOAP 1.1 fault writer on a servlet container (2011). This is the JAX-WS reference implementation bundled with JDK 8, publishing Provider endpoints on the JDK's own HTTP server with Endpoint.publish, for SOAP 1.1 at /soap and SOAP 1.2, with the SOAP 1.2 HTTP binding, at /soap12.

The endpoints are this set's Store.java, Soap11.java and Soap12.java, written for the recording: they throw SOAPFaultException with faults built by SAAJ, which the runtime serializes and sends with its own status and headers.

exchanges.name: soap11-missing-owner
exchanges.description: SOAP 1.1, a call without Owner: a sender fault with an empty detail.

exchanges.name: soap11-not-found
exchanges.description: SOAP 1.1, an unknown id: a sender fault with DocumentNotFound in its detail.

exchanges.name: soap11-conflict
exchanges.description: SOAP 1.1, a document another owner has locked: a receiver fault with LockConflict in its detail.

exchanges.name: soap12-missing-owner
exchanges.description: SOAP 1.2, a call without Owner: a sender fault with an empty detail.

exchanges.name: soap12-not-found
exchanges.description: SOAP 1.2, an unknown id: a sender fault with DocumentNotFound in its detail.

exchanges.name: soap12-conflict
exchanges.description: SOAP 1.2, a document another owner has locked: a receiver fault with LockConflict in its detail.
